title: 第十一章 赌与剑第十二章 一战再战
slug: 盗三界第五百六十章黑影
lines: 班主任洪亮的声音响彻整个教室：
“现在抓紧时间，复习一下各门功课，重点是符箓。”
“八点半广播一响，班长带队，全就都下去，在操场上热身等候。”
“我提醒你们所有人注意——”
“这一次，各大高校都派了专人来看，你们务必要拿出自己的最佳状态，好好表现。”
“都记住了吗？”
“记住了！”同学们一起大声回答。
班主任转身匆匆走了。
——今天月考，又要接待各个大学来人，到处人手不够，老师们都很忙。
“还有吃的没有。”
许源悄声问。
“你饿鬼投胎啊，简直了。”
赵阿飞从抽屉里拿出一粒丹药，递过来。
许源闻了闻，便将丹药丢进嘴里，慢慢咀嚼起来。
——这是品级不错的辟谷丹。
除了不好吃之外没缺点，营养也是够够的。
许源经常从赵阿飞这里混点东西。
——赵阿飞家是一个品牌丹药的省级经销商，算得上是狗大户。
相比之下，许源家就清贫了许多。
再加上许源母亲生病，父亲常年不在家。
许源自己也有点“鬼火少年”的那种青春期做派，一言不合就动手。
其他同学都不怎么跟许源来往。
只有赵阿飞这个死党，一直跟他称兄道弟。
“以后剑术考试的时候，你就用我的剑——我的剑比学校提供的公用剑具好使多了。”
赵阿飞从桌子下抽出一柄剑，在许源眼前晃了晃。
不等许源说话，他又飞快说道：
“这次小组战，你要罩一罩兄弟我。”
“怎么？出什么事了？”许源诧异地问。
“被家里亲戚鄙视了，很不爽——许哥，这次我们好好考，行不？”阿飞一脸苦大仇深模样。
“那必须行，我会稍微认真一点。”许源拍拍他肩膀道。
他将那柄剑接过来，放在手上掂了掂。
微光小字顿时浮现：
“秀影。”
“剑器，精良级。”
“重影3级：战斗时激发出三道重影迷惑敌人。”
精良级！
这效果施展开来，简直又拉风又有威胁度。
氪金玩家使人愁。
——就算在修行世界也一样！
许源叹口气，忽然想起一事，把剑先还给赵阿飞，然后默念一声“商店”。
虚幻的商店顿时在他眼前展开。
眼见其他同学都视若无睹地继续读书，许源便将那柄“夜行”短刀按在手中。

The class teacher’s loud voice resounded throughout the classroom:
"Now seize the time and review each lesson, focusing on the talismans."
"As soon as the announcement goes out at 8:30, the squad leader will lead the team. Everyone will go down and warm up on the playground to wait."
"I would like to remind all of you -"
"This time, all major universities have sent special personnel to watch. You must show your best and perform well."
"Do you remember everything?"
"Remember!" the students answered loudly.
The head teacher turned around and left in a hurry.
——Today is the monthly exam, and we have to receive people from various universities. There are not enough staff everywhere, and the teachers are very busy.
"Is there anything to eat?"
Xu Yuan asked quietly.
"You are reincarnated as a hungry ghost, that's it."
Zhao Afei took out a pill from the drawer and handed it over.
Xu Yuan smelled it, then threw the elixir into his mouth and chewed it slowly.
——This is a good-grade Bigu Pill.
There are no shortcomings except that it is not delicious, and the nutrition is sufficient.
Xu Yuan often gets some stuff from Zhao Afei.
——Zhao Afei's family is a provincial distributor of brand-name elixirs, and can be regarded as a big business.
In comparison, Xu Yuan's family was much poorer.
In addition, Xu Yuan's mother is ill and his father is not at home all year round.
Xu Yuan himself is a bit like a "will-o'-the-wisp boy" in his adolescence, always taking action whenever he disagrees with someone.
Other classmates didn't have much contact with Xu Yuan.
Only Zhao Afei, his best friend, has always called him brother and sister.
"In the future swordsmanship exams, you can use my sword - my sword is much easier to use than the public swords provided by the school."
Zhao Afei pulled out a sword from under the table and waved it in front of Xu Yuan's eyes.
Without waiting for Xu Yuan to speak, he quickly said:
"In this group battle, you have to cover me, brother."
"What? What happened?" Xu Yuan asked in surprise.
"I feel very unhappy about being despised by my relatives - Brother Xu, let's take the test seriously this time, okay?" A Fei looked bitter and resentful.
"That must work, I will be a little more serious." Xu Yuan patted him on the shoulder and said.
He took the sword and weighed it in his hand.
The dimly lit characters suddenly appeared:
"Xiuying."
"Sword weapon, sophisticated grade."
"Ghost Level 3: Excites three ghost images to confuse the enemy during combat."
Excellent grade!
When this effect is unleashed, it is both exciting and threatening.
Krypton gold players make people sad.
——It’s the same even in the world of spiritual practice!
Xu Yuan sighed, suddenly remembered something, returned the sword to Zhao Afei, and then said "store" silently.
The illusory store suddenly opened before his eyes.
Seeing that other students continued to study as if they were not paying attention, Xu Yuan pressed the "Night Walk" short knife in his hand.
title_en: Chapter 11 Gambling and Sword Chapter 12 Fight again and again
